missions.name: Dead Stock in Specific Categories
missions.query: What are the top 5 product categories with the highest dead stock (inventory stock count <= 0) across all locations?

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Variance
missions.query: What is the average lead time variance (actual lead time - expected lead time) for each supplier, grouped by category?

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies in Popular Styles
missions.query: What are the top 5 product styles (style_name) with the highest variation in size distribution (size count) across all locations?

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches by Supplier
missions.query: What are the top 3 suppliers with the highest number of reorder point breaches (stock_count <= reorder_point) across all locations?

missions.name: Channel-Specific Sales Trends
missions.query: What are the top 3 sales channels (channel) with the highest sales growth rate (units_sold) across all products, compared to the same period last year?

missions.name: Country-Specific Supplier Performance
missions.query: What are the top 2 countries (country) with the highest supplier on-time rate (on_time_rate) across all suppliers?

missions.name: Product Price Variance by Category
missions.query: What are the top 5 product categories with the highest price variance (retail_price) across all products, compared to the average retail price?

missions.name: Supplier Delay Risk Analysis
missions.query: What is the probability of supplier delays (lead_time_days > 30) for each supplier, grouped by category, and what is the expected impact on inventory stock count?

missions.name: Dead Stock by Category
missions.query: What are the product categories with the highest percentage of dead stock (inventory stock count <= 0) across all locations, and what is the average retail price of these categories?

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Anomalies
missions.query: What are the suppliers with lead times significantly higher than their expected lead times (lead_time_days > expected_lead_time), and what is the impact on inventory stock count?

missions.name: Inventory Price Inflation
missions.query: What are the product categories with the highest average price inflation (retail_price / unit_cost) over the last quarter, and what is the impact on revenue?

missions.name: Supplier Delay Risk
missions.query: What are the suppliers with the highest probability of delay (lead_time_days > 30) for each product category, and what is the expected impact on inventory stock count?

missions.name: Supplier Breach Probability
missions.query: What are the suppliers with the highest probability of breach (stock_count <= reorder_point) for each product category, and what is the expected impact on inventory stock count?

missions.name: Category Sales Concentration
missions.query: What are the product categories with the highest sales concentration (units_sold / total_units_sold) across all locations, and what is the impact on inventory management?

missions.name: Supplier Country Concentration
missions.query: What are the countries with the highest supplier concentration (supplier_count / total_suppliers) across all product categories, and what is the impact on supply chain risk?

missions.name: Channel Revenue Concentration
missions.query: What are the sales channels with the highest revenue concentration (revenue / total_revenue) across all product categories, and what is the impact on revenue diversification?

missions.name: Inventory Reorder Point Optimization
missions.query: What are the product categories with the highest inventory turnover ratio (units_sold / inventory_stock_count) across all locations, and what is the optimal reorder point for each category?

missions.name: Price Elasticity Analysis
missions.query: What are the product categories with the highest price elasticity (price sensitivity) across all locations, and what is the impact on revenue?
